title: A Machine for the Static
author: Felix Reyes
blurb: Elodie Nystrom, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
